name: event-choice
description: Fortify event: Khan (largest population) may permanently fortify one of its cities, or add 2 troops to each of up to two cities. Its HQ city China faces 9 Enclave troops.

args.title: Fortify
args.text: Whomever has the largest population may either fortify one of his cities (if there are still fortification marks left) OR may select up to two cities he controls. Add 2 troops to each of those cities.

options.label: Fortify one of your cities
options.hint: Permanent: +1 to both defence dice in that city in every future game (10 uses); this card is destroyed.

options.label: Add 2 troops to each of up to two of your cities
options.hint: Immediate: up to 4 more troops now.
